The Gauhati High Court on Friday designated 41 advocates from Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh as Senior Advocates. The decision was taken at a full court meeting held today. The list of advocates conferred the senior designation, along with their place of practice, are as under: Assam Anan Kumar Bhuyan: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Barnali Chowdhury: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Biswajeet Goswami: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Budh Karan Kejriwal: Tinsukia Bar Debajit Kumar Das: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Debajyoti Talukdar: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Dileep Kumar Kothari: Kamrup (Metro) Bar Gautam Baishya: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Gayatri Goswami: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Hridip Kumar Das: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Jayanta Chutiya: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Manjula Das: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Md. Abdur Razzaque Bhuyan: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Mohendra Nath Dutta: Golaghat Bar Mrinmoy Dutta: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Neelanjan Deka: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Niranjan Narayan Bhuyan Choudhury: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Pallab Kataki: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Parangam Narayan Goswami: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Parswajyoti Das Nair: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Pronoy Kumar Roychoudhury: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Raka Bejoy Phookan: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Ranjit Kumar Bhuyan: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Ranjit Kumar Dev Choudhury: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Rintu Goswami: Jorhat Bar Roushanara Choudhury: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Santanu Borthakur: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Shyam Dutta: Dibrugarh Bar Shyamal Seal: Dibrugarh Bar Smritishree Chakravarty: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Subhajit Banik: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Subhash Chandra Keyal: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Tarun Chandra Chutia: Principal Seat, Gauhati High Court Nagaland Ashipri Zho: Kohima Bar Mizoram Dinari T. Azyu: Aizawl Bar C. Zoramchhana: Aizawl Bar F.
